$comment: Check catalog. report.py evaluates every check from stage outputs (never from prose) and maps the result to a severity with these rules. Verdict: any BLOCKER -> UNSAFE; else any MAJOR -> NEEDS_CHANGES; else any MINOR -> SAFE_WITH_NITS; else SAFE. INCONCLUSIVE replaces SAFE/SAFE_WITH_NITS when a required stage did not run.

checks.title: Head test suite passes (cargo test --all-features)
Compiles with RUSTFLAGS=-D warnings (CI)
rustfmt clean on changed files
Cargo.lock in sync (--locked)
JS lane: yarn build / test / tsc (when bindings change)
GitHub CI checks on the PR
parcel_selectors crate tests (not run by CI)
Builds with --no-default-features
wasm32 compile gate (CI test-wasm compiles cfg(wasm32) code only there)
C bindings build and c/lightningcss.h is up to date
Generated files in sync (build-prefixes.js output, ast.d.ts)
Source changes come with tests in src/lib.rs (or tests/, node/test)
New test cases exercise the change (fail on base)
Changed expectations are browser-equivalent to their input
No existing expectation removed while behavior changed
Harness fidelity: recorded head expectations reproduce through the adapter
No regression in current engines (base equivalent -> head different)
New/changed test outputs are equivalent to their input in current engines
No new declarations/selectors/conditions rejected by an engine without a surviving fallback
Lowered output in legacy engines within targets matches the modern rendering
No new near-miss (color/number drift within tolerance)
Pixel-identical rendering for visual areas
WPT property cases do not regress
Every behavioral delta was verified or classified
Engines disagree on the input: the spec decides (classify with a spec or WPT citation)
No new panic / crash / timeout
Output is stable under re-minification (idempotent)
Deltas stay inside the declared areas (or are explained)
Real-world minified size does not grow (> 0.1%)
Overlapping open PRs identified
No consistent slowdown on the real-world corpus (release build; optional `lcr perf`)
Release binary size does not grow by more than 1% (optional `lcr perf`)
Spec checklist for the affected areas
Linked issue repro fixed on head (fails on base)
Analysis complete (every slot filled with evidence)
